paragraphs: He is mentioned in Zohar Chadash, Ruth, at פ״ב; see there for the awe-inspiring incident.

notes.text: The locator פ״ב could represent a chapter label or pagination and requires an edition check.

The later saved named Zohar Chadash, Midrash Rut 438–439 selection explicitly identifies the boy taught Scripture, prayer, Mishnah and Talmud as Rabbi Nachum HaPekuli. This provides a digital match for the incident pointer after the earlier failed request. It does not verify supplied פ״ב as chapter or folio. No Nishmat Chayyim snippet or name etymology is adopted.

Hyman prints פ״ב in this notice (vol. III, p. 922). The incident can be found in Zohar Chadash, Midrash Rut 438–439 in Sefaria’s numbering. The pointed Wikisource text has the same incident under its folio marker 103a. The differences in numbering leave the edition behind Hyman’s citation uncertain.
